messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the low-bit canary — saw a recurring spike in hallucination/factuality errors on long summarization prompts when using int4 fallback. Want to decide whether to tighten per-profile thresholds or add a per-request hysteresis before switching bits.
ryan: Can you share the minimal repro + the metric curve? :mag:
maria: Pasting snippet and a tiny summary: 30% of sessions hit >0.08 factuality_drop after token 512. Repro: short prompt + long context. Config we used:
```
precision_profile: 
  name: lowlat
  candidate_bits: [int4, int8, fp8]
  degrade_trigger: 0.08  # factuality drop
  immediate_fallback: true
```
deepa: Immediate fallback is cheap conceptually but kills KV reuse and causes full cache flushes — big latency/throughput hit. We need a hysteresis window (e.g. require N contiguous tokens or a short time window) before flipping.
simon: Agreed. Also we should avoid per-token telemetry churn. Suggest adding a "quality_budget" float on the profile that counts expected degradation units and only triggers fallback when budget exhausted. Keeps transitions rate-limited.
ryan: +1 on budget model. Also: runtime API change proposal — include a new header `x-redwood-profile-hints: bits=int4|int8;budget=0.25` so routable frontends can prefer or avoid certain nodes. Need to spec the header format.
maria: That header works. We should also tag telemetry with `quant_path` and `profile_id` to make split analysis trivial.
deepa: Operational concern: when fallback happens we must emit a span and a compact event for oncall to correlate with cache evictions. Otherwise SREs will be chasing ghosts.
ops-bot: deploy: canary to eng-ml infra at 3001002400 — runtime change includes `profile_hints` header parser and telemetry labels.
simon: On storage/contract: profiles should be stored in JSON at control-plane but use a protobuf compacting shim for runtime. Keeps human-editable + efficient transport.
ryan: Eval work: add a dedicated metric `factuality-surge@k=512` and a degradation-weighted latency cost so we can tune the budget parameter. We'll run a sweep on the summarization workload next week.
maria: Decision summary: (1) implement hysteresis via `quality_budget` + require 3 contiguous token degradations or 200ms window; (2) add `x-redwood-profile-hints` header; (3) add telemetry tags `quant_path` + `profile_id` and a compact fallback event; (4) store profiles as JSON + protobuf transport shim; (5) add eval metric `factuality-surge@512` and schedule sweep. I'll open the implementation tickets and tag owners. :white_check_mark:
ryan: Thanks — please add an ops play for emergency pin (pin to fp8) if `factuality-surge` exceeds threshold for 5m.
maria: Will do.
